venue.name: Mini Festival Ground (Reference Sample)
venue.description: Minimal three-zone reference venue: one entrance gate feeding a central gathering ground, discharging through one exit corridor. Built as the smallest topology that still exercises every part of the schema. The capacity figures are deliberately under-provisioned on the outflow side so that the Bottleneck Physics Engine has a real bottleneck to find: inflow capacity is 238 persons/min while outflow capacity is 158 persons/min, restricted further to ~95/min by the exit barricade's current setting. All thresholds are uncalibrated engineering estimates.

topology_version.change_note: Initial reference topology accompanying SPEC-v1 requirement N-3.

density_bands.basis_note: Engineering estimate. Entrance queueing areas are held to lower density bands than open ground because arriving crowds are directional and cannot easily reverse.

risk_profile.notes: Arrival surges are externally driven (transport arrivals), so inflow here is only partially controllable.

density_bands.basis_note: Engineering estimate only. Standing-crowd density bands require venue calibration and review by a crowd-safety practitioner before any operational reliance.

risk_profile.notes: single_egress is true: this zone has exactly one outward connection, so any restriction on e-ground-to-exit removes all egress capacity. A hazard-override candidate.

density_bands.basis_note: Engineering estimate. Moving corridors tolerate lower standing density than open ground before flow breaks down.

risk_profile.notes: Modelled as the egress terminal: the graph terminates at the venue boundary. terminal_discharge_capacity_per_minute represents the street mouth beyond, which is finite - treating an exit as an infinite sink is a standard egress-modelling error.

flow_capacity_basis.reference: min_width_meters 3.6 m x 66 persons/min/m, a conservative free-flow specific-flow figure from pedestrian planning practice. Not venue-measured.
min_width_meters 2.4 m x 66 persons/min/m. The governing constriction is the portal, not the 4 m corridor beyond it.

dynamic_state.reason: Configured default: barricade set to meter outflow onto the public street at event start.

control_points.name: North Gate
control_points.notes: Closing this halts all inflow. Safe to close at any occupancy: it reduces inflow without touching egress capacity.

control_points.name: East Exit Barricade
control_points.notes: Governs the ONLY egress from main-ground. Setting this to `closed` while main-ground is occupied must be rejected by the safety invariant in SPEC FR-064: it would reduce total egress capacity to zero. Moving it to `open` restores full portal capacity (158/min from ~95/min) and is the primary intervention this venue affords.

extensions.sample_note: Reference instance for CROWDShield SPEC-v1 requirement N-3. Numbers are illustrative and uncalibrated. Validate with schemas/venue-graph.schema.json plus the cross-reference integrity pass described in that schema's top-level description.
